title: FIRST: Federated Inference Resource Scheduling Toolkit for Scientific AI Model Access
problem: Lack of scalable, on-premises AI inference infrastructure for scientific workloads with privacy constraints
motivation: Scientific communities need private, secure, scalable inference without relying on commercial cloud infrastructure
method: Federated inference framework using Globus Auth/Compute, multiple inference backends (vLLM), auto-scaling with hot-node management
key_novelty: Cloud-like Inference-as-a-Service on federated HPC clusters with OpenAI-compliant API and cross-cluster distribution
contributions: FIRST framework for federated AI inference
Support for billions of tokens daily on-premises
